question: How does circuit order determine a matrix product, and how can every single-qubit unitary be reconstructed by a phase-tracked Z-Y-Z factorization?
entry: Exact3.5 rotation matrices and Bloch actions; transitive2.3 basis/orthogonality and3.3 orthogonal partner. Local2x2 determinant expression defined without a general determinant theorem.
exit: Demonstrate noncommuting orders, derive unitary column form and global phase, multiply ZYZ and extract parameters including both endpoint singular cases.
